product_metadata.title: Bread Making Tools and Supplies - Set of 3 - Danish Dough Whisk, Bread Lame, Bench Scraper - Dough Hook with Bread Scraper, Lame Bread Tool, Blades - Great for Baking Sourdough, Pizza, Pastry by LHU
features: 3 ARTISAN BREAD BAKING TOOLS - Do your dough right. Achieve professional bread making results in your home kitchen with our 3 piece sourdough bread baking supplies set that includes a Danish dough whisk, a bench scraper, a bread lame tool and 5 bread lame blades

ORIGINAL DUTCH DOUGH WHISK - Also called a Danish dough hook, this unique tool is strong enough to mix the thickest no-knead bread dough, but gentle enough to blend the most delicate fluffy pancake batter. Reduces clumping and mixing time to improve bread texture.

BREAD LAME WITH 5 BLADES - The lame bread tool allows for accurate dough scoring with double edge stainless steel blades and a comfortable beechwood handle. Decorate your own signature loaves by making smooth, controlled cuts resulting in creative, artistic patterns.

BENCH SCRAPER KITCHEN TOOL - Our multipurpose bench scraper, cutter and chopper easily scrapes and splits dough with a heavy, straight stainless steel edge. Use it to divide, portion, scoop, and transfer hunks of dough or scrape loose flour from the countertop.

DO YOUR DOUGH RIGHT WITH LHU - Classy matching beechwood handles bring a warm, rustic feel to our eco-friendly and artisan quality bread making tools. Transform home baking and bread making into an enjoyable and elevated experience with LHU. One Year Limited Warranty.
